description:
Status: CARDED, not started. Found during signed-sentiment-fanout research (pending
refuter confirmation there; verify before building).

## Symptom

The dashboard chart's source selector (Aggregated / Tiingo / Finnhub / Our Model)
renders the identical line in all four modes.

## Mechanism (two stacked causes)

1. Ingestion constructs `source_id = f"dedup:{dedup_key}"`
   (`src/lambdas/ingestion/handler.py:1035`, the only construction site). Analysis
   passes it into the fanout, so every timeseries bucket's `sources` entry starts
   with `dedup:`, never `tiingo`/`finnhub`/`our_model`. The mode filter in
   `src/lambdas/dashboard/ohlc.py:1074-1080` compares against those names, so every
   non-aggregated mode filters out every bucket and returns empty history. Test
   fixtures assume `"tiingo:91120376"` format (`tests/unit/test_sentiment_history.py:164`);
   production data diverged from the fixtures.
2. The frontend hides the emptiness: see specs/001-chart-stale-series/card.md.

## Fix sketch

Carry the real provider through ingestion into `source_id` (or a parallel field), or
have analysis derive it. Decide the format against the sibling endpoint's
`startswith` filter (`src/lambdas/dashboard/sentiment.py:623`) and the 400-rejection
of `our_model` in `router_v2.py:1494-1496`. Old buckets keep `dedup:` sources until
TTL ages them out; the filter needs a story for mixed data.
